// @camis:generated — do not edit; regenerated by camis
import { announceArticle } from "../../../../hooks/announce-article";
import { forgetArticle } from "../../../../hooks/forget-article";
import { guardDelete } from "../../../../hooks/guard-delete";
import { reindexArticle } from "../../../../hooks/reindex-article";
import { reslug } from "../../../../hooks/reslug";
import { slugify } from "../../../../hooks/slugify";
import { transformTitle } from "../../../../hooks/transform-title";

export default {
  async beforeCreate(event: { params: { data?: Record<string, unknown> } }) {
    const { data } = event.params;
    if (data) {
      const out = slugify.run({ title: data.title as never });
      data.slug = out.slug;
    }
  },
  async afterCreate(event: { result?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
    const { result } = event;
    if (result) {
      announceArticle.run({ title: result.title as never });
    }
  },
  async beforeUpdate(event: { params: { data?: Record<string, unknown> } }) {
    const { data } = event.params;
    if (data && data.publishedAt) {
      const out = transformTitle.run({ title: data.title as never });
      data.title = out.title;
    }
    if (data) {
      const out = reslug.run({ title: data.title as never });
      data.slug = out.slug;
    }
  },
  async afterUpdate(event: { result?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
    const { result } = event;
    if (result) {
      reindexArticle.run({ slug: result.slug as never });
    }
  },
  async beforeDelete(event: { params: { where?: Record<string, unknown> } }) {
    const entry = await strapi.db.query("api::article.article").findOne({ where: event.params.where });
    if (entry) {
      guardDelete.run({ slug: entry.slug as never });
    }
  },
  async afterDelete(event: { result?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
    const { result } = event;
    if (result) {
      forgetArticle.run({ slug: result.slug as never });
    }
  },
};
